description: Each tablet contains 500 mg of paracetamol.
use: The Indian leaflet lists relief of pain and fever.
caution: The leaflet warns that using another medicine containing paracetamol at the same time can harm the liver.
source: Crocin India · leaflet, page 1, sections 2 and 4

description: Each tablet contains the equivalent of 20 mg of pantoprazole. It has a coating that resists stomach acid.
use: The Indian leaflet lists acid reflux and ulcers in the stomach or the first part of the small intestine.
caution: The leaflet warns about allergy to ingredients in this product.
source: Alkem Laboratories · PAN 20/40 leaflet, sections 2, 4.1 and 4.3

description: One capsule has two medicines. The pantoprazole pellets have a coating. The domperidone pellets release the medicine slowly.
use: The Indian leaflet lists acid reflux, when stomach contents flow back into the food pipe.
caution: The leaflet lists circumstances where these medicines must be avoided. A pharmacist can check the full list against your other medicines.
source: Alkem Laboratories · PAN-D leaflet, sections 2, 4.1 and 4.3
